[[File:Sith_Speeder.jpg|thumb|A FC-20 speeder bike]]
'''Razalon''' was a small [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufacturer active during the later decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was known to have produced a number of unusual designs, including the [[FC-20 speeder bike/Legends|FC-20 speeder bike]] employed by the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].
